body: Three read-back options chosen by JayArr, 2026-10-12: (1) 'Source' for the outside chat's write-up, after the mirror checked both studies; (2) 'Start it here', so the Why Log opens in the project with W-13 and W-14, with W-1 to W-12 to be pasted in; (3) 'Map it to Q3': file W-14's type as a Why-log type pointing to question 3, with Andrews as its first outside evidence, and no new concept.
plain: The Kentrou 2024 / Andrews 2022 write-up is a source; the Why Log starts in this project; 'lumped category' maps to master question 3 rather than becoming a new type.
